verdict.rationale: BAMF is Germany's Federal Office for Migration and Refugees, a government agency and information portal covering asylum, migration, integration and return programmes. It is not an AI agent or host application that could act as an MCP client, so plugging MCP servers into it is a category error. Nothing in the evidence suggests it ships any agentic or MCP client capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
